units.source_text: 话一走题，难免让人不明白，还是言归正传吧。

en.t: When the talk strays from the point, it is bound to become confusing, so let me return to the subject.

units.source_text: 我自认为，能够写这封长信，说明比起处境与我相同的人来，我多少还是比较淡然处之的。

en.t: I think that the very fact I can write this long letter shows I am, at least somewhat, calmer than others in the same position.

units.source_text: 夜深人静后，电车的声响已停歇，不知何时，木板套窗外传来幽幽虫鸣，

en.t: Late at night, after all had grown quiet and even the sound of the streetcars had ceased, faint insect cries began to come from beyond the wooden shutters.

units.source_text: 使人不觉想起眼下正值银露霜秋，一无所知的妻子在隔壁睡得香甜。

en.t: They made me think unawares that it was now the dewy autumn season, while my wife, knowing nothing, slept peacefully in the next room.

units.source_text: 我拿着毛笔，一笔一画地刷刷地写着，

en.t: Holding the brush, I write stroke by stroke with a soft rustling sound.

units.source_text: 此时此刻，我的心情毋宁说是平静如水的，虽说笔尖会由于不常写字而滑出线外，但绝非头脑混乱，信笔胡写。

en.t: At this very moment, my mind is rather as calm as still water; although the brush tip may slip outside the lines because I am unused to writing, I am certainly not confused and scribbling at random.
